steps.en: Install the package for your language; a prebuilt native binary comes with it
steps.zh: 按语言装包，自带预编译的原生二进制
steps.code: npm install @firecrawl/anydoc · pip install firecrawl-anydoc · cargo add anydoc

steps.en: Hand it a file path, or raw bytes from your upload or queue
steps.zh: 把文件路径或上传来的原始字节交给它

steps.en: Reads the format from the bytes themselves, so a mislabeled file still converts
steps.zh: 从字节本身认出格式，扩展名写错也能转

steps.en: Parses the file into one shared model: headings, lists, tables, footnotes, assets
steps.zh: 解析进同一个文档模型：标题、列表、表格、脚注、附件

steps.en: Renders every format through one Markdown writer; a scanned PDF errors with NeedsOcr
steps.zh: 所有格式走同一个 Markdown 输出器；扫描版 PDF 报 NeedsOcr

steps.en: Feed the Markdown to your LLM or RAG pipeline; set failed files aside
steps.zh: 把 Markdown 喂给 LLM 或 RAG 管线，转不了的文件另行处理

value.en: Mixed Office, OpenDocument, EPUB and text-PDF files become one Markdown style, with no LibreOffice or model
value.zh: 各种 Office、EPUB、文字版 PDF 统一成一种 Markdown，不装 LibreOffice

sources: https://github.com/firecrawl/anydoc README: Quick start (npm install @firecrawl/anydoc, pip install firecrawl-anydoc, cargo add anydoc, anydoc.to_markdown("report.docx")), Format detection, Errors (NeedsOcr), How it works diagram (format detection -> format parser -> Document -> GFM serializer)
https://github.com/firecrawl/anydoc/blob/main/src/formats/pdf.rs (PDF path via pdf-inspector, NeedsOcr on flagged pages)
